questions.question: What was the concern about the daughters of Zelophehad marrying?
options: That their inheritance might pass to another tribe
That they were still too young to marry
That they had wholly abandoned the ancient faith of Israel
That their wealth would make them proud
questions.answer: That their inheritance might pass to another tribe

questions.question: What was the solution given?
options: They were forbidden to marry at all
They forfeited their share of the land
They were to marry within their own tribe
They had to move to another region
questions.answer: They were to marry within their own tribe

questions.question: The daughters of Zelophehad obeyed and married within their father's tribe.
The daughters were to marry within their own _____ so the inheritance stayed in it.
This ruling kept each tribe's _____ from passing to another tribe.
